rationale: I accept the exact v17 extension catalog and native audit. All 49 accepted additions map to the signed candidate across 27 affected challenges, with zero collision diagnostics. Each live core matches the archived seeds, target, recipes and displayed routes. I replayed the archived routes and independently recomputed minimum action par before and after merging the additions. Every affected challenge keeps its existing par, and all added pairs are reachable before a win. The 33 alternative seed pairs and 16 alternative finishing pairs stay within each core concept set and leave existing pair results intact. For example, Lacul Bâlea and Munții Făgăraș provide an additional way to finish Transfăgărășan while keeping the two-action par. Affected challenges expose 5 to 24 recipe pairs, with at most eight productive opening pairs. Across 68 selectable challenges the 472 core pairs plus 49 additions give 521 pairs. The audit confirms graph provenance and binds the exact proposal to the current pack, rankings, quick and world catalogs, KG and rubric.
